params.title: AVG-verzoeken
params.description: AVG (GDPR) data-subject-rights verzoeken: inzage/portabiliteit, verwijdering (retention-guarded via de statutaire bewaarplicht) en rectificatie, uitgevoerd via OpenRegister's DsarService onder een expliciet vastgestelde beheerderssessie (avg-dsr). Alleen-beheerder surface.

params.title: AVG-verzoek
params.note: avg-dsr (2026-07-16): guarded api-call actions, NOT lifecycleActions -- DsrRequest.status carries no x-openregister-lifecycle map (design.md D3/D5): every transition requires a caller-role check (admin-ONLY, deliberately never widened to isAdminOrHr -- DsarService::assertPrivileged() hard-requires actual IGroupManager::isAdmin()) plus an explicitly-established DsarService-privileged session plus, for verwijdering, the statutory-retention guard (REQ-DSR-005) -- a retention-locked object (e.g. a Payslip inside its AWR 7-year window) is NEVER erased, always reported labelled 'retained (wettelijke bewaarplicht)'. Bevestig verwijdering REQUIRES a prior Voorbeeld verwijdering recorded on the SAME request (REQ-DSR-006). The Rectificeer action's `changes` payload is not yet collected via a prompt (the manifest v2 api-call action type has no free-text field-map prompt) -- the LoonbeslagDetail withdraw `reason` precedent; a prompt-collecting modal is a named fast-follow (README). Admin-only surface -- one notch stricter than the Payroll group's admin/HR posture. Audit history is a sidebar tab.
